What you've been shown here is somewhat like a letter in a sealed envelope. If you give it to someone who can read and tell her, "Read this," she'll say, "I can't. The envelope is sealed."
And if you give it to someone who can't read and tell him, "Read this," he'll say, "I can't read."

You shut God out and work behind the scenes, Plotting the future as if you knew everything, acting mysterious, never showing your hand.
You treat the potter as a lump of clay. Does a book say to its author, "He didn't write a word of me"? Does a meal say to the woman who cooked it, "She had nothing to do with this"?
